address: 54-296 Kamehameha Hwy, Hauula, HI 96717, United States

reviewText:
Loved the beef quesadillas with beans and rice. Highly recommend.

I’d give 5 stars but the guacamole wasn’t very good. The shrimp taco and special sauce were delicious though!

Loved this place enough to comeback a second time while still on vacation.

*If you found my review helpful, I would greatly appreciate a thumbs up (like) so google and I know. Thanks, and Bon appétit!
